items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Of course, Billy sang there, and I accompanied him.

ctx.x: Of course, Billy sang there, and I accompanied him. Accompanied him.

Yeah. That's always a word to get around. Yeah. The reason I was asking is that I was -- you've mentioned Cab Calloway, of course, and Teddy Hill a number of times, and I brought up Billy Eckstine. In the late '30's and early '40's some of the musicians who later were the major innovators of bebop were involved in those bands,
